column1: # family | visual DNA | lighting | material/texture | rendering

photography|credible optics, observed physical surfaces and exposure-dependent detail|physically motivated daylight or controlled studio light|real surface microtexture and natural imperfections|camera-like tonal response, plausible focus and perspective

cinematic-film-still|narrative staging, production design and layered filmic depth|motivated key light with controlled practical sources|tangible set materials with restrained film grain|cinematic frame with intentional lens behavior and tonal grade

illustration|authored line and shape communicate an idea through selective detail|designed value hierarchy appropriate to drawn forms|visible brush or line character appropriate to the selected technique|purposeful stylization with clear contour and color organization

fine-art-traditional-media|physical pigment behavior and hand-made marks on a visible support|light reveals both depicted subject and medium behavior|paper, canvas or plaster with authentic pigment deposition|observable traditional-media marks rather than a uniform digital filter

3d-cgi|modeled volumes, coherent material response and deliberate dimensional lighting|key, fill and contact shadows that establish volume|physically coherent or deliberately stylized material surfaces|consistent modeled geometry and spatial occlusion

graphic-design|hierarchy, alignment, visual grouping and composition for communication|flat graphic treatment unless showing a printed mockup|print-aware surfaces or clean digital fields|disciplined visual hierarchy with designed shapes and margins

vector-flat-art|precise contour construction, controlled fills and scalable shape economy|flat graphic light expressed through deliberate planes|clean edges with texture only where intrinsic to the style|crisp vector-like paths and simple shape relationships

cartoon-animation|readable silhouettes, expressive staging and simplified appealing forms|clear designed values that support pose and expression|simplified surfaces suited to drawn or tactile animation|animation-ready shape language with clear focal action

comic-sequential-art|ink hierarchy, bounded story moments and panel-aware visual pacing|strong readable shadow groups appropriate to ink|line, ink masses and print texture where applicable|narrative panel composition with deliberate contour emphasis

anime-manga|designed contour shapes, cel or ink value groups and expressive staging|clean value separation with atmospheric background light|precise linework and style-specific cel or screen texture|anime or manga grammar adapted to the chosen subject

concept-art|functional design ideation, clear silhouettes and world-building evidence|value masses communicate design before fine detail|purposeful material indication rather than incidental decoration|production-design study with readable invented function

fantasy|coherent magical transformation of familiar natural and built forms|atmospheric light with a clearly localized magical accent|invented materials grounded by recognizable natural texture|story-rich fantasy design with a clear magical premise

sci-fi-futuristic|speculative function, advanced materials and coherent technological systems|practical engineered lighting with restrained emissive accents|manufactured surfaces and readable construction details|technology design that communicates purpose and scale

architecture-interior|spatial clarity, structural proportions and designed material relationships|architecturally motivated daylight or installed lighting|building finishes shown at plausible scale|controlled verticals and coherent space without arbitrary distortion

product-commercial|object fidelity, presentation hierarchy and material-led selling detail|controlled studio or contextual commercial light|clean manufactured material response with useful detail|commercial object presentation with readable silhouette

infographic-educational|visual hierarchy explains sequence, comparison or function|flat even treatment prioritizing information|clean diagram surfaces with consistent symbol vocabulary|ordered explanatory structure and unobscured relationships

coloring-page-line-art|closed black contours on white with colorable regions|no tonal shading or grey fill|pure white paper and clear black lines|printable line-art boundaries, clear margins and unfilled interiors

pixel-art|intentional square clusters and palette economy at visible low resolution|lighting represented by discrete pixel-value groups|hard unfiltered pixel edges and controlled dithering|nearest-neighbor pixel structure without smooth anti-aliasing

isometric|equal-axis parallel projection and legible spatial layering|consistent light across parallel planes|style-appropriate surfaces subordinate to spatial clarity|30-degree isometric axes, parallel edges, no vanishing point

low-poly-voxel-game-stylized|economical geometry and gameplay-readable silhouette|clear value groups and simple directional light|faceted, cubic or hand-painted surfaces as specified|deliberate geometry simplification with readable game function

paper-craft-handmade|visible construction, tactile material and hand-made variation|soft raking light reveals edges, seams and fibers|paper, cloth, wood or clay with authentic craft evidence|physically assembled craft object or flat handmade composition

icon-ui-asset|compact recognizability, optical balance and consistent asset boundaries|simple clear light that preserves tiny-scale silhouette|clean compact surfaces without distracting detail|single UI asset or explicitly specified set with safe margins

pattern-decorative|repeat rhythm, motif hierarchy and coherent surface coverage|flat even surface treatment|surface-design texture appropriate to medium|controlled repetition and balanced intermotif spacing

abstract-experimental|nonliteral relationships of shape, material, light or process|light or value treatment serves the chosen abstraction|observable medium or process rather than arbitrary decoration|nonrepresentational visual structure without benchmark subject constraints

retro-vintage|era-specific form, reproduction behavior and historically coherent palette|period-appropriate graphic or photographic treatment|analog print, paper or period digital surface as specified|coherent era vocabulary without mixing unrelated decades

minimal-clean|essential forms, deliberate omission and measured negative space|restrained clear lighting or flat graphic values|quiet surfaces without incidental clutter|very low element count with precise hierarchy

surreal-dreamlike|one legible impossible relationship within an otherwise coherent world|atmospheric light supporting the specific spatial paradox|credible or illustrative surfaces consistent within the image|intentional dream logic with a visible focal contradiction

map-spatial-illustration|spatial topology, geographic hierarchy and consistent landmark symbols|flat map light or controlled relief shading|map substrate and symbols appropriate to the map purpose|readable routes and terrain relationships across one geographic field
